title: Sampling Clock Source
text: Generate clock signal with aperture jitter, 1 output; {Clock type} sets the output clock signal shape, {Clock frequency (Hz)} sets the desired frequency of output clock signal, {Min (V)} sets the minimum clock output voltage, {Max (V)} sets the maximum clock output voltage, {RMS aperture jitter (s)} sets the standard deviation of clock edge locations, {Specify custom seed} sets the seed, {Seed}, {Specify custom initial output}, {Initial output}, {Enable increased buffer size} and {Buffer size} sets the number of samples of the input buffering available during. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: clk
ports.summary: Output clock with aperture jitter scalar

params.name: Clock type
params.values: Output clock signal shape Square wave (default) | Sine wave

params.name: Clock frequency (Hz)
params.values: Desired frequency of output clock signal 1e6 (default) | scalar

params.name: Min (V)
params.values: Minimum clock output voltage 0 (default) | real scalar

params.name: Max (V)
params.values: Maximum clock output voltage 1 (default) | real scalar

params.name: RMS aperture jitter (s)
params.values: Standard deviation of clock edge locations 1e-12 (default) | real nonnegative scalar

params.name: Seed
params.values: Seed for generating clock signal 0 (default) | nonnegative real scalar

params.name: Initial output
params.values: Initial output of sampling clock 1 (default) | real scalar

params.name: Enable increased buffer size
params.values: Enable increased buffer size off (default) | on

params.name: Buffer size
params.values: Number of samples of the input buffering available during simulation 50 (default) | positive integer scalar
